description: Cartographie Open Street Map des gares Transilien is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by OpenStreetMap. Equipements des gares cartographiés par OpenStreetMap sur le réseau SNCF Ile-de-France. Ce jeu de données est mis à jour à mesure qu'avance la cartographie dans les gares. Exportez au format geoJSON, GPX ou KML depuis Vous avez des questions ou des remarques sur ces données ? Rendez-vous sur le forum SNCF Open Data. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Transports en commun, Accessibilité, Géolocalisation. The portal shows 2014-05-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
